name: XNLI
description: Cross-lingual Natural Language Inference (XNLI) extends the MultiNLI dataset to 15 languages via crowdsourced translation and professional review. Each premise-hypothesis pair is labeled as entailment, neutral, or contradiction. Tests both cross-lingual transfer (train English, evaluate in other languages) and multilingual evaluation.
reputation: Standard cross-lingual NLI benchmark; introduced at EMNLP 2018; widely used to evaluate multilingual models like mBERT and XLM-R
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2018. 15 languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Greek, Bulgarian, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Vietnamese, Thai, Chinese, Hindi, Swahili, and Urdu. 5,000 dev + 5,000 test examples per language. Subset of MultiNLI with translations. Standard benchmark for evaluating zero-shot cross-lingual transfer in multilingual models.
